messages.author: f20966e9bc9cf5c7
messages.subject: dodge stat_sum geoms?
parts:
Dear all,

so i just figured out how to dodge stat_sum geoms.
The problem: the summary geom is not placed correctly.

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mpg, aes(as.factor(cyl), displ, color=drv)) +
geom_boxplot() +
stat_summary(fun.y="max", geom="point", shape=23, fill="white")

The solution: pass arguments to the respective geom.

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mpg, aes(as.factor(cyl), displ, color=drv)) +
geom_boxplot() +
stat_summary(fun.y="max", geom="point", shape=23, fill="white",
position=position_dodge(width=.75))

I figured i would share. It would be nice if that was handled
automatically.

Have a nice day!

Cheers,
Brian

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: dodge stat_sum geoms?
parts:
In ggplot2, layers are independent so the point later doesn't know that there is a boxplot layer that you want to align with.

Hadley
